agentSessions.import.note: tests/agent_sessions.rs: imports transcripts of the last 30 days (max 100) as threads with the last 200 text messages and the native session id so the provider resumes; idempotent. Tool calls and thinking are not reconstructed; transcripts are never written.

agentSessions.scan.note: tests/agent_sessions.rs: scans $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects and $CODEX_HOME/sessions (bounded files/bytes/line length, read-only, nothing cached), groups by directory, reports matching projects and alreadyImported.

assets.createUrl.note: Real-client signed grants cover all resource tags, Range/HEAD, session/scope/canonical-boundary rechecks. GTK theme inheritance/XDG icon downloads, content-selected cached media and expired-cache collection tested. Partial: MCP HTML injection, complete platform discovery, media formats/host adapters. Tool-output images require orchestration:read; file grants require filesystem:read. 2026-11-02: isolated pinned 3991 comparison downloads identical HTML attachment bytes through actual Connection.asset_bytes. Consumer correction: no production caller sets renderIntent:mcp-app (only optional lib API descriptors); desktop src/documents.rs:10 fetches an ordinary inline attachment and ui/qml/T3Backend.qml:1202 supplies its own bridge. MCP HTML injection is not an established consumed asset gap. Actual media readers remain desktop src/videos.rs:28 and Android core/transport/NativeT3Transport.kt:70; this run does not certify every media format/adapter. No status change. 2026-11-02 audit implementation: .aac/.opus/.avi/.ogv MIME mappings match desktop classifier; real asset_bytes downloads workspace media fixtures through signed createUrl. Existing confinement, content selection, identity and scope checks retained. Codec decoding and every host adapter remain unproven.

orchestration.dispatchCommand.note: Actual client Command, approval, queue, timeline, sidebar and awareness readers execute on server output; acceptForSession survives idle reap; imported native references share launch validation. Native control delivery has no exactly-once acknowledgement: uncertain handoffs are recorded as delivery-unknown, never replayed. Accepted limits: other-owner and delegated-cohort cases with no client flow; RECOVERY.md's exact original-process reattachment. See CONFORMANCE.md. 2026-11-02 audit implementation: historical fresh forks materialize bounded uploaded attachments and serialized historical context, excluding later runs; deterministic Claude/Codex peers assert provider-received image bytes and timeline reader output. Per-message provider selection shares identity reset/handoff with explicit selection; same-instance model changes retain identity. tests/model_handoff.rs includes failing-before controls. Oversize handoffs fail explicitly; arbitrary native context beyond stored conversation remains unproven.

orchestration.searchThread.note: Implemented and tested with a real Connection, but no production caller: desktop ui/qml/T3Panel.qml:193 and Android ui/thread/TimelineReader.kt:87 search the loaded transcript locally, and lib-t3-rust has no RPC reader for it. Reclassified by independent audit on 2026-11-02.

orchestration.searchThreadStream.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.searchThreads.note: Real Connection verifies metadata, shells, project/state filters, FTS plus folded substring fallback (4096 rows, 64K characters/row, 8 MiB scanned text), and title exact/prefix/substring priority. Partial: full palette word-boundary/recency/branch/pick scoring and matches beyond the fallback budget. 2026-11-02: pinned 3991 exposed title-only hits incorrectly returned as default message matches (docs/p1-reader-before.json). Default search now excludes title-only hits; explicit titlesOnly remains. Real lib search_threads regression plus isolated differential compares ordered hits and attachment bytes. Full message ranking, fallback budget and older-settled equivalence remain unproven; no status change. 2026-11-02 audit implementation: positive pinned 3991 message queries compare actual lib-reader snippets and result order. Long snippets include the folded-accent match safely within 240 Unicode characters. User-before-assistant, recent thread, and per-thread message selection replace BM25 ordering. Explicit title scoring retained. Fallback budgets and exhaustive ranking remain unproven.

orchestration.stopWorkflow.note: No provider control stops a workflow; answers OrchestrationV2StopWorkflowError(unsupported). tests/admin_reads.rs.

orchestration.subscribeArchivedShell.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.subscribeCommandOutput.note: Real Connection verifies bounded command tails, replacement/final output. Bounded CR/backspace/CSI progress folding handles split sequences and long rewritten lines. Real Claude 2.1.316 Bash probe supplies output only at completion; Codex exposes outputDelta. Partial: live Claude command output unavailable on observed protocol; arbitrary multiline VT unsupported. 2026-11-02: tests/command_output.rs now applies actual server subscription frames to lib parity::output (Android commandOutput.apply), in addition to desktop-style text assembly. Completion-only Claude delivery is not newly proven against 3991 here; multiline VT equivalence remains unproven. No blanket live-output parity claim. 2026-11-02 audit implementation: split CSI vertical A/B/E/F movement folds within bounded retained rows, with live and settled actual parity::output reader coverage. Adversarial large moves remain bounded in time and size. 256 KiB input/final and 64 KiB tail limits retained. Not a full terminal emulator; complete VT and live Claude delivery parity remain unproven.

orchestration.subscribeShell.note: Real Connection background/identity/replay coverage plus Codex quota failure/reset and usage_limit error class via schema-based synthetic native peer; Claude rejection reset/error class projected. Still partial: required realistic captured exhausted-provider failure frame is unavailable; synthetic evidence is explicitly not a real capture. See CONFORMANCE.md.

orchestration.subscribeThread.note: Real lib reducers and timeline, queue, approval, compaction-candidate and sidebar readers run on server output. Gated Codex vs isolated T3 3991 passes strictly: two subscribers, request-before-result window, unique run creation, terminal causality, exact replay order and identity, stable ID relationships. One recorded reference-only exception: lastSnoozeWakeAt null-to-absent in T3's replay, which no client reads. Reader-state equality, not JSON equality of every record. Accepted limits: other-owner and delegated-cohort cases with no client flow; RECOVERY.md's exact original-process reattachment. See concurrent-reader-report.json and CONFORMANCE.md.
